description: Use this when the user asks whether the SuppCo Buying Club carries an alternative to a specific product, usually one they already take. Returns that product plus Buying Club products in the same category with TrustScore, price, member price and cashback.

certifications.description: Required certifications, comma-separated. Valid: gluten_free, non_gmo, vegan_action, usda_organic, nsf_sport, usp_verified, informed_sport, informed_choice, tested_by_suppco.

form.description: Comma-separated product forms. Valid: capsule, tablet, softgel, gummy, powder, liquid, other.

priority.description: How to rank alternatives. Valid: best_value, most_trusted, most_popular, most_expensive. Defaults to most_trusted.

product_id_or_slug.description: The product to compare against the Buying Club — usually one the user already takes (e.g. from suppco_get_my_stack). A UUID, slug, or product name.

name: suppco_compare_to_buying_club
title: Compare to Buying Club
